title: Trente et Quarante
betGuide: Pick a bet and a stake, then deal. Two rows (Noir, then Rouge) are dealt to 31+; the lower row wins.

betType.couleurDesc: First card's color matches the winning color
betType.inverseDesc: First card's color differs from the winning color

result.refait: Refait — a tie at 31. Half your stake is lost.

tutorial.betControls: Choose one of the four bets and enter your stake
tutorial.actionButtons: Deal both rows, then start the next round
tutorial.results: The two rows, their totals, and your result are shown here

hint.evenMoney: All four bets are even money with the same edge — Noir is the traditional default
